title: I NEED HELP PLEASE !!! how to shift text

posts.author: belhadi
posts.body:
Hello everyone, I desperately need help with text dialogs.
as you can see on the screen, my text is stuck how to shift text to top left and I want to shift it so that the text can be read better. I've searched everywhere but nothing.
does anyone have any idea on the solution?
thank you !

posts.body:
Personally, I don't see a problem with the text appearance so I must be missing something. Is it being cut off or something? It isn't all showing?

posts.author: fizzly
posts.body: \PX[x] and \PY[y] define the text position, if you set the offset to 10,10 in plugin parameters, just skip the \PX and \PY codes in message, it should work just fine. If you have \PY[10] then all the text is always at position Y=10, that's why it looks like this.
